en: Captain, why are you in\nsuch a hurry?
Are you looking for Coro?\nI haven't seen him around\nhere―sorry!
I'll help look for him! I'll let\nyou know if I see anything.
Captain!
I need to show you how I\ntruly feel!!!

Behold―the "ChocCoro"!
It's an exact chocolate
replica of me, with
features measured down
to the picometer!
Added to that, it's\nlife-size!
I even managed to\nperfectly recreate my\ninnards!
I'm getting heartburn just\nfrom looking at it...

I poured my heart and
soul into it! What do you
think, Captain? I hope you
can accept how I truly
feel!

Um... Just how exactly is
this chocolate statue
supposed to represent
your feelings, Coro?
Well, when I was checking\nmy database a while back,\nI learned something...

It seems that in a certain
region of Earth, they
customarily give candy to
people who help them out
over the course of the
year.

When I found out about
that, I could not help
myself! I shut myself in
the kitchen and got to
work!

I simply cannot contain
the gratitude that is
welling up inside me,
Captain! I need you to
accept these feelings!

What do you mean, "forget
about that and hurry up"?
You seem awfully
flustered suddenly...
Hey! Stop it! Don't pull it\nso hard!
Aaaaaaah!!! My other me!
M-my true feelings...\nS-smashed to bits...
This is a time for action,\nnot crying? How terrible,\nCaptain. My feelings...!

Hm? I tipped over my oil
cooler when I was running
around making the
chocolate?

And now it's wrecked the
console? And I also spilled
my juice on top of it and
shorted out the
machinery? And now the
bridge is on fire!?

AND you say that it
caused a malfunction that
initiated the self-destruct
sequence!?
Aaaagh! I am so sorry! I\nwill deal with it right away!

Captain! I'm not cut out
for much more than
firefighting, but I will do
what I can!
Off we go!!!

Event achievement
unlocked! Take a look by
tapping the Achievement
Button.

Oh, Captain! Thanks so
much for the other day.
Your quick action saved
us all.

Oh, think nothing of it.
When there's a crisis on
this ship, it goes without
saying that we all pitch in.

Oh, by the way―what
happened to that
chocolate statue of Coro
from the other day?
I stuck it back together.
I've been eating it bit by\nbit.
I molded it into a\nChocCaptain statue.
Ah, I suppose that's the\nfinal product over there.
Ugh... The heartburn flares\nup every time I look at it...

Well, now that your
chocolate is back the way
it was, Coro must be
pretty happy.
(The captain is so nice.)
Oh, um... It's nothing.\nNothing you need to worry\nabout at all.

I see you've accepted
Coro's...gift. And you're
even eating it. How very
kind you are, Captain.
Only to avoid wasting\nfood? You don't have to\ndeny it so strongly...
And here I thought you'd\ntaken Coro's feelings to\nheart.
Is... Is that the life-sized\nstatue over there!?
Don't tell me this one has\nperfectly recreated\ninnards, too...
It's like some terrifying\nmannequin right out of my\nnightmares, Captain...
Well, regardless...this\nholiday "Vale n' Twine,"\nwas it?

It's a day when you
exchange chocolatey gifts
to show gratitude to those
you're close to, right?

I guess we don't have
many chances to express
thanks to one another, so
this sounds like a good
chance for it.
Maybe I should try making\nsomething, too...
What are you up to, Clair?
Thank you for taking the\ntrouble to come all the\nway here, Reimi.
Oh, um... What's that\ncharred stuff?

I wanted to bake a
chocolate cake for
Valentine's Day, but it
turned out like this...

I heard from the captain
that you were good at
making sweets, Reimi. Do...
Do you think you could
teach me?

Of course! I've been
feeling the urge to make
something sweet for a
while now. This will be
great!
Thank you! You're a\nlifesaver.
That said, I never imagined\nthat making treats would\nbe so difficult...

I'm accustomed to
preparing military
provisions, so it came as
quite a shock.

Well, of course! It's just as
the captain said. There's a
lot of cookware here that
you might not be used to!

That does make some
sense, but I worry there's
something else I'm
missing...
Anyway, let's give this a\nshot together!
Thank you so much, Reimi.

tapping the Achievement
Button.
Hi, Clair! Thanks for the\nchocolate cake!
I cannot eat it, but will\nnever forget how beautiful\nit was!
You're welcome. I'm glad\nyou liked it.
And thank you, Reimi. It\nwas all thanks to you that\nI managed to bake it.

Oh, think nothing of it. I
was super impressed by
how quickly you mastered
the basics.
Hehe.
Oh, it just made me think\nof my father. He taught\nme how to cook...

He was a larger-than-life
character, whose forte
was far from baking
delicate cakes.
However, he sure knew\nhow to use pots to make\nthe most delicious meals...
You know, Clair, I just\ncan't picture you having\nsuch a lively dad.
Oh, is that so? I happen\nto think I resemble him.

My father was my model
in all things, not just the
combat arts. I wanted to
learn to be just like him.
Not that I could ever tell\nhim that... He would just\nmake fun of me for it.

So... I guess in some ways
if I could give anyone in
the universe chocolate,
it'd be him.
What is it?
Oh, uh... I was just thinking\nof who I want to give\nchocolate to...
...Huh?
Oh hey, Clair! Did you\nknow about this?

On Valentine's Day, girls
sometimes give chocolate
presents to boys they like
as a way of showing their
true feelings.
Huh?
So that means...

Clair is basically
confessing her love to
everybody in the crew by
handing out chocolate
gifts!
Huh? Huh!?
Why, Clair... It seems you\nare quite the sly little\nminx!
S-sly minx? Me!? Wh-what\ndo you mean by that!?

It is a term for a woman
who likes to toy with her
men! It is listed in my
database.
I confessed my love...to\neveryone? I'm toying with\nall the men...?
WHAT HAVE I DONE!?
Coro! Captain! Please, give\nme those cakes back! I'm\nrecalling them all!

Ah. Well, first, let me run
this cake through my 3D
scanner... Hold on just a
second...
I'm done asking!
Hey, the cake vanished!
It's not that big of a deal,\nreally. Nobody's taking it\nthat seriousl―

I can't accept platitudes
like that! This is serious!
I'm going to go get the
rest back!
Ahh, she's gone...

Hehe... Funny, isn't it,
Captain? I thought Clair
was all cool and collected,
but she has her quirks.
I should get to know her\nbetter.
